description: Today's date in a time zone, in the Hebrew, Islamic, Chinese and other calendars. More APIs from FitzTopPicks: https://fitztoppicks.com/apis?utm_source=mcp-api&utm_medium=mcp&utm_campaign=more-apis

afterSunset.description: True when the time is after sunset: Hebrew and Islamic dates move to the next day (their days begin at sunset).

method.description: Islamic method: umalqura (default, Saudi Arabia's official calendar), civil or tabular.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. America/New_York, Asia/Jerusalem (default UTC).

to.description: Calendars to return, comma-separated (gregorian, hebrew, islamic, chinese, persian, indian, ethiopian, coptic) or "all". Default: gregorian,hebrew,islamic,chinese.

name: today
title: Today in other calendars
